summary.answer: Delegate arg0 to SetZMOfflineScreenStateToCustomGame, with no explicit return. This is an already selected shared UI edge, not a new Zombies investigation. Create an output list and get the current menu and playlist groups. Walk nonhidden groups whose mode is available (or has no EMode) and matches the menu mainmode. Walk entries; FEATURED accepts featured nonexcluded entries, PUBLIC accepts nonfeatured nonexcluded entries, ztutorial checks the first rotation gametype asset, and other nonnil tabs require a single excluded-public rotation, the zclassic difficulty condition and matching grouped gametype. Reject unavailable quickplay cards after those tests, append accepted entries, return the list. Data and first-rotation indexing remain unguarded.

summary.answer: On the same file-local module table that is exported as CoDShared through the reused ReadOnlyTable proxy, loads the current lobby menu by native screen ID and returns whether its lobbymode equals the supplied argument. No absent-menu guard is shown. Returns a boolean local: true is possible only when same-table IsOnlineGame()==true, not matchmaking_manual and not the second exact hashed game mode. Else false. Module export is source-qualified only; native mode values and original VM/loading remain unknown. Returns Engine.getdvarbool(com_sv_running) directly through the exact module export. No authority, host identity or network-service behavior is inferred beyond this recovered source expression. In order returns true for loot_fakeall, positive native ownership count or default-unlocked helper. Otherwise, with fallback name list, iterates names and returns true only when both values from IsLootItemOwnedByNameSimple are truthy. All remaining paths return false. Does not infer catalog or actual ownership from source.
